keywords: Land Development Ordinance – Nomination of successor – Original permit holder initially nominating several persons including petitioner – Later cancellation and nomination of 2nd respondent as sole successor shortly before death – Later nomination registered one day after permit holder’s death – Validity of nomination dependent upon registration before death – Meaning of “registered” – Delay in presentation for registration – Public holiday/weekend argument – Statutory registration requirement – Certiorari and Mandamus sought in relation to competing nominations.
legistation: Constitution – Article 140; Land Development Ordinance No. 19 of 1935 – sections 19, 60 and 72; Interpretation Ordinance – section 8(2) and statutory meaning of “registered.”
